desc:
Tutorial: Building the Simplest Possible Linux System - Rob Landley, se-instruments.com

This tutorial walks you through building and booting the simplest possible Linux system, first under QEMU and then on real hardware. We cover kernel configuration and building, native vs cross compiling, initramfs creation (and other root filesystem options), installing and booting, the init process and system
